questions.question: What project did young King Joash of Judah set his heart on?

answers.text: Repairing the house of the LORD

questions.question: King Joash told the Levites to quickly collect money to repair the house of the LORD. The Levites hurried right out to do it. True or false?
After the repairs to the house of the LORD under King Joash were finished, what was done with the leftover money?

answers.text: It was used to make articles for the house of the LORD
It was stored away in the king's treasury
It was handed back to the people of Judah

questions.question: Why was the priest Jehoiada, who guided King Joash, buried with the kings in the City of David?

answers.text: He did what was good in Israel for God and His temple
He ruled Judah as king while Joash was young
He led Judah's army to a great victory in battle
